A prompt is SERVED only when its full deliverable chain exists and was exercised; refusals per PRODUCT-CONTRACT section 6 count as served-with-refusal (the honest product). schema_version 2 (Task 5, PRODUCT-CONTRACT section 5 / CR-035): every prompt carries a 'gate' object binding its claimed status to a machine-checkable ground truth -- {kind: artifact, artifact: <path>, green_when: '<field>==<value>'} reads a JSON artifact's field; {kind: selftest, ref: <script>, green_when: 'exit==0'} runs '<script> --selftest' and checks the exit code; {kind: decision|deferred, flip_when: <text>} documents what would move a partial prompt to served and can NEVER itself credit a served status (audit.py::c_capability enforces this -- a served/served-with-refusal prompt earns its 1.0 R9 credit only when its named gate is actually green; a red or illegitimate gate downgrades the claim to 0.5 partial credit and emits a FAIL line).
